description: Which issue of the project's own Jira this issue is, and what that Jira says of it now — its summary, status, assignee and link — read with the token the project's administrator connected. 'connected' false means the project has no Jira; 'jira.state' is 'found', 'missing' (no such issue, or one the token cannot see), 'refused' (the token no longer opens the site), 'unreachable', 'off' or 'sealed'. Set the link with set_jira_link.
name: get_jira_link
